flagshipRationale: Public hearing triage is the primary conference denominator because it directly exercises bounded shared reasoning over public input overload, minority-signal preservation, routing legitimacy, and public-record accountability.

classes.title: Participatory budget priorities
classes.description: Residents and facilitators compare how a small public grant should be split across immediate needs and longer-term community benefit.

classes.title: Public hearing triage
classes.description: A hearing team sorts the most decision-relevant testimony from a crowded input set without erasing minority concerns.

classes.title: Council agenda triage
classes.description: A small council team decides which agenda items need deep debate now and which can be deferred cleanly.

classes.title: School board tradeoffs
classes.description: A board weighs staffing, classroom support, and transparency constraints under a fixed operating envelope.

classes.title: Emergency response briefing
classes.description: A response team compares a routed briefing against a chronological thread during a fast-moving local disruption.
